build_commands: sh -c 'tsc --target ES2022 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --allowJs $(find . -name '"'"'*.ts'"'"' -not -path '"'"'./node_modules/*'"'"' -not -name '"'"'*.d.ts'"'"' 2>/dev/null) ./subject.ts || tsc --target ES2022 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck ./subject.ts'
interface: Run /app/run.sh as a JSON-lines service. Requests contain id, op="run", call="entry", and args (an array of positional arguments). Return one JSON object per request, preserving id: {"id": id, "ok": true, "value": result} or {"id": id, "ok": false, "error": message}. Do not write diagnostics to the response stream.
